# The exact bytes Seccomp.program assembles, one line per architecture and
# profile, as architecture, profile and the instructions in hex. The descriptor
# the gated profiles are built against is 9.
#
# Captured off the implementation as it stood before the syscall layer moved to
# Fiddle, so the rewrite has something to be equal to. A line that changes here
# means the filter a script runs behind changed, which is either the point of
# the commit or a bug, and there is no third case.
#
# Regenerated when the io_uring calls joined the deny list: three more
# comparisons and the errno return they jump to, four instructions per
# program, which is why every line here is longer than it was.
aarch64  compile            
aarch64  runtime            
aarch64  runtime_open_exec  
aarch64  runtime_open_files 
x86_64   compile            
x86_64   runtime            
x86_64   runtime_open_exec  
x86_64   runtime_open_files
